ProjectWeave request for the selected Task (data): {"task": {"id": "I_kwDOUDROfM8AAAABejhStw", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BlR_zzhIEltc", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BlR_z", "number": 335, "title": "Remove standalone TranslateGemma legal warning footer; keep terms on its model card", "body": "## Goal Remove the **separate, warning-styled legal notice at the very bottom of the Models page** that starts “Before using TranslateGemma 4B, read …”. Put the relevant Google Gemma terms, prohibited-use policy, and attribution link **on the TranslateGemma model card** instead. This is a **UI cleanup**, not removal of legal information or changes to terms/consent. ## Verified current implementation - [`extension/model-cache.html`](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/blob/main/extension/model-cache.html) currently has a `
` containing **both**: - A paragraph with **Supertonic / Kokoro / TTS terms and notices / matching eSpeak NG source** links. - A paragraph: `Before using TranslateGemma 4B, read Google Gemma Terms, Prohibited Use Policy and attribution.` - [`extension/models.css`](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/blob/main/extension/models.css) gives the **entire footer** special warning-colored border, background, padding, and text. This is why the notice appears as an oversized independent warning panel. - [`extension/model-cache.js`](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/blob/main/extension/model-cache.js) already creates a **TranslateGemma 4B** card with its own link to `../web/licenses/gemma-notices.txt` and a model-specific note that the Gemma Terms of Use and Prohibited Use Policy apply. ## Requested behavior 1. **Remove the standalone bottom-of-page TranslateGemma warning paragraph** and the separate warning-box presentation. Do not merely hide the text while leaving an empty bordered footer or blank space. 2. **Keep the TranslateGemma card's own legal link**, pointing to the same `gemma-notices.txt` content. Use a concise context-accurate label such as **License & terms** or **Gemma terms & attribution**, in coordination with [#332](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/issues/332), which shortens model-card legal link labels. 3. Preserve adequate, discoverable **notice of Gemma usage restrictions and attribution** at the appropriate model card/link destination. Do not remove actual legal documents, mandatory attribution, or any existing consent/approval steps (if any) associated with preparing/using the model. If a concise contextual note is needed to communicate nonstandard terms before download, place it **in that model's card**, not a full-page footer warning. 4. **Important:** The current footer also contains **TTS and eSpeak NG licensing/source links**, added/retained during the storage management cleanup. Do **not** accidentally remove them! Move any required notices/links into the matching **Supertonic 3** and **Kokoro** cards, or another unobtrusive and logical legal location, before removing or neutralizing the footer. Preserve these exact destinations where relevant: - `../web/licenses/tts-notices.txt` - `../web/tts-assets/phonemizer-source.tar.gz` - Any other currently included required TTS notices/attribution. 5. Remove obsolete styling for the footer's standalone alert panel in `extension/models.css` if no other warning footer remains; maintain appropriate model-specific notice styles when warranted. 6. Keep model download, integrity verification, status/error handling, and cache functionality unchanged. ## Acceptance criteria - [ ] Models page no longer shows a standalone yellow/orange/alert-styled TranslateGemma paragraph at the bottom. - [ ] TranslateGemma card provides a clearly labeled, accessible link to Google Gemma terms, prohibited-use policy and attribution; destination remains correct. - [ ] Appropriate disclosure of the relevant terms is maintained without a duplicated page-wide warning. - [ ] TTS/Supertonic/Kokoro/eSpeak NG license, notices and source links currently present in the footer remain accessible after cleanup and are not silently deleted. - [ ] No empty footer, orphaned border, or excessive bottom whitespace remains on desktop/mobile layouts. - [ ] Model download and status flows are unaffected; relevant UI, links and accessibility tests pass. ## Touchpoints and related issues - `extension/model-cache.html`: bottom footer and license links. - `extension/model-cache.js`: TranslateGemma card and any relocation of TTS/eSpeak NG notices. - `extension/models.css`: footer warning-style CSS. - UI/documentation/tests for Models page. Coordinate with: - [#332](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/issues/332) — short legal/source links on model cards. - [#326](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/issues/326) — storage-management panel removal and preservation of TTS/eSpeak notices. - [#324](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/issues/324) — simplify Models page overall. Out of scope: deleting licenses/attributions, changing legal obligations, changing model packaging, model preparation or inference behavior.
